text:
alex: heads up — noticed weird spikes in billing attribution when the batch router handles requests with per-request authz headers. two customers hit higher token counts and their project billing didn't match.

maria: ugh. do you have a minimal repro or logs? this sounds like the router might be dropping org/project headers during batching :thinking:

alex: quick paste from logs:
```
RouterBatcher: batch_id=0x7f3 headers=[X-Org: 12345, X-Project: 42]
AuthzCheck: approved -> identity=sa-analytics@org-12345
BatchSplitter: emitting 3 requests -> target=dedicated-pool-7
Serving: attributed_to=project:unknown tokens=512
```
It looks like attribution becomes "project:unknown" after we split the batch on the dedicated pool handoff.

jon: that snippet is great. my guess: the handoff path forgets to propagate the original origin header when we rebuild per-request metadata. we've had off-by-one in the header mapping before around the split stage.

leigh: could also be a timing window where the KV cache returns a stale origin mapping and we fallback to unknown. Are these requests hitting prefix-KV cache misses?

alex: two traces show identical behavior with and without cache hit — so I think it's in the router -> handoff serialization. attaching trace ids in case you want to pull them: trace: T-3498bd, T-3498be

maria: thanks. tagging ops-bot to surface recent deploys around 11:01 UTC.

ops-bot: deploy: routing-service v3.14.2 deployed at 2025-04-18T11:00:53Z by ci/cd. No rollbacks.

jon: ok that aligns. v3.14.2 introduced the batching micro-optimizations (PR #4821) which touched header marshalling. assigning to me to triage.

leigh: quick mitigations? can we force per-request attribution at serving layer until fix shipped? maybe a conservative fallback that preserves original header string across split.

alex: that would help customers now. also would like better telemetry: if attribution flips to unknown we should emit a debug metric with batch_id and route to help fast rollback decisions.

maria: agree. jon — can you add a short metric and a feature flag to gate the old marshaller? we want minimal perf impact.

jon: yep. I'll push a hotfix branch with the flag + metric. estimate ~2h. will post PR link.

alex: sweet. once that's in, can we run a quick canary in dedicated pool-7 for the affected orgs?

jon: yes — will coordinate with @maria for canary targets and with @leigh for KV cache warmup.

leigh: I'll prepare a small warmup script to reduce misses and monitor attribution. also will add an alert if project attribution drops >0.5% in any pool.

maria: thanks team. followup: we should add a unit test for header marshalling across batch split and a small e2e to assert billing attribution header survives handoff.

alex: adding to backlog. moving this to a short incident-free patch unless the fix shows other regressions. :thumbsup:
